scope: Formula-level IV-C inversion on existing datasets and fixed original full-gallery calibration. k20/50/100/200 reflect paper; k1 is explicitly our task adaptation, not reported original regime. No training or model selection.
inversion: Smallest alpha on fixed grid for which strict count of distance (or raw cumulative similarity) < threshold is <=k; matches IV-C strict inequality, distinct from IV-A set <=. No eligible alpha: sentinel u=1 and unresolved flag. Grid is our declared choice, not author-provided code.
confidence: 1-u used solely for descriptive10-equal-width-bin ECE against top-k same-ID presence. No conditional probability guarantee.
decisions: k1 confidence-ranked top10/25/50pct answers with stable original query order on ties. Same L2 candidate per case; no reranking, no learned calibration. Empty conformal set can satisfy <=k; count this explicitly without silently forcing nonempty.
budget: CPU cached features; no GPU/new data; expected <4min including independent review
followup_scope: Pre-fixed formula-identical CAMP repetition on existing cohorts. No new independent data or reversal of original Sample4Geo efficacy gate.
